items.title_orig: Giving new Dub names to a couple Stands (they probably don't follow copyright)
items.article_text:
Diamond is unbreakable:
 Deadly Queen (Killer Queen): Killer King. Not my favorite name change but I feel like it keeps the name idea intact. Killing Queen was also a contender.
 Worse Company (Bad Company): Worst Company. I don't know why they used Worse and not Worst in the actual dub??
 Show off (Surface): Copycat. It doesn't keep the sub name intact but well it copies people so it makes sense in my head.
 Boy Man Man (Boy ll Man): Boy/Man (said like Boy Slash Man)
 Highway Go Go (Highway star): Freeway Star. I personally like Highway Go Go but I know others don't so I came up with this.
 Pole Jam (Pearl Jam): Pear Jam. I just took away the L in Pearl. Opal Jam (All Star Battle) is also a good rename.
 Cat Plant (Stray Cat): Rouge Cat. It's just another word for stray. Feral cat from Al
